body · Barlow 400 · 18/1.5 · 68ch

In DLP stereolithography, the dimensional accuracy of printed parts in the XY-plane depends strongly on two factors: the projected image size and the exposure time. I created a print procedure that let an operator calculate both correction factors and hold repeatable accuracy better than 50 µm.

Lewis Lab photography & illustration

Role
Photography · Video · 2D illustration
With
Jennifer A. Lewis group, University of Illinois
Years
2010 – 2013
Place
Urbana, Illinois
Appeared in
Advanced Materials (3), JACS, Electronics Letters, Energy Procedia, IEEE AWPL, C&EN
Tags
caliperphotographyillustration

Alongside his thesis research, SJ photographed, filmed and illustrated the work of other researchers in the Lewis group. Eight of those images and illustrations ran in published papers, and one video, on drawing conductive silver ink from a ballpoint pen, was picked up by Chemical & Engineering News.

The brief for each was the same: make a microscopic or chemical process legible to a reader who has thirty seconds and no microscope.
